body:
## Summary
- reject diagnostic-only telemetry, summary-only latency JSON, and latency preflight artifacts as closing evidence for `telemetry_and_latency_archive`
- recognize the real `latency_gate_preflight` kind as preflight-only while retaining legacy `latency_preflight` compatibility
- require formal latency reports to be profile-consistent, external-hardware-backed, and revalidated through `source.manifest`
- document that internal telemetry is diagnostic-only; closing evidence still requires retained raw external-camera media or synchronized-clock physical-input proof

## Verification
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v` -> 81 tests OK
- CLI smoke: forged pass aggregate with only summary-only `glass_to_glass` JSON + Android live-smoke report writes `aggregate_verdict=insufficient` and reports `latency summary artifacts are summary-only`
- `make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> exit 0, wrote summary with `aggregate_verdict=blocked`, `can_mark_phase0_stable_release=false`, and `telemetry_and_latency_archive` still insufficient
- `make evidence-tools-test` -> 1458 tests OK
- `make release-tools-test` -> 425 tests OK
- `git diff --check` -> OK

## Boundaries
- No Vibe Screen, MacHost, or Telemachus GUI was launched.
- No `swift run`, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, TCC, System Settings, or `adb reverse` command was used.
- This is offline gate hardening only; no new external-camera raw media or synchronized-clock physical-input evidence was produced.
title: Harden telemetry latency archive gate
